strengths: Plate update confirmed. The live plate reproduces exactly from comp_prism.py's current defaults (bshade 0.86, topspec 0, glint 0; maximum difference 0). Against the previous plate (composite_r3's r3_clamp.png), 26,836 px change and every one is darker (median −17.7 levels, luminance ratio 0.862). All of them lie on the back links and the strip between the sweets (plate x 199–761, y 1387–1612; frame x 215–821, y 636–879). Nothing else in the plate moved.

At full size the back row now sits in the back sun's shade like the front faces, so the loop's light is consistent. Its tops stay bright through the blend, with no seam at 2x. The back-row stones are a touch duller (median 164,123,103 to 145,109,91). At 390 px the darker back row gives the loop more depth, and no tell shows.

Nothing else moved. The config is unchanged since r14, every layout element sits at its r14 box, and the copy and foot measure exactly as in r14: headline 14.2:1 (darkest 5% 14.0), correction 14.1:1 (13.9), spec 13.2:1 (12.4), price 12.9:1 (11.9), ink wordmark 4.7:1 (3.6), 43 px above the price. The correction still clears the left purple sweet by 39 px. Between the copy and the foot the render equals its new background to the pixel.

It hits every lever: the account's proven line and props ('Almost edible. cubic zirconia, not candy.', 10 of 16 concept sales) around the real listing photo, which fills 68% of the width. Prism at ₹2,399 and in stock, a candy pun, a light peach ground, Feed 4:5. Every claim is a listing fact.

[brand, minor] The 1.08x upscale costs about 11% of the front row's fine detail against the old 0.88x frame. The pavé still resolves at 2x, and the difference is invisible at 390 px.

[ceiling: photo] Still a 9.5 plate (composite r5 calls it a better 9.5). The link tops keep the listing's soft studio highlights with no hard sun sparkle, and the dark notch at the pink sweet's right rim remains (frame x 778–805, y 713–768; about 3 × 20 px at 390). Ceiling 9.5.
